checks.observed: Existing session, privacy, optional connection and portable data controls render after schema upgrade.

coverage: Schema-1 kv data survives schema-2 upgrade
Scoped canonical documents, command records and append-only events share a transaction
Quota fault after initial write rolls every table back
Concurrent compare/exchange admits exactly one writer
History identity/order remains immutable while equivalent field ordering is accepted
Canonical and legacy records survive page reload
Strict typed journal codec, identity checks and scoped adapter interop
Export/restore preserves IDs and command history; conflicts preserve existing state
Imported in-flight requests become unknown; copied undispatched leases return to pending
limitations: Browser tests use isolated synthetic origins, separate from the app database.
Mobile devices, physical eviction and mixed-version rollout remain unqualified.
Canonical workspace UI/export/clear integration and remote APIs remain the cloud-workspace dependency.
